items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Wasn't Bill Bourgeois in there at one time, too? ... Well, Bourgeois played that before then. ... Well, Bill could play better than them at the time.

ctx.x: He's playing a lot. At the gym hotel, he's playing a sound when he saw him. Eddie Miller. I got Eddie Miller and Fazz Ola, the first job I ever had at the front dance on both of them. And Eddie played better. In those days, Eddie played better clarinet than Fazz. And Fazz played better, I mean, and Eddie played better tenor than Fazz. So he swapped around, see. And we had Eddie Miller and Fazz at the same time in the front, see. And we had a good kick in the back, man. Wasn't Bill Bourgeois in there at one time,…
